country_decisions: CFG-DEM-012: whether the nation's law obliges an institution to answer a finding, and how its response is published (none ship).

CFG-DEM-012: independent institution mandates and protected access boundaries (who is named for the oversight slot, its standing and independence, recorded through the institution register; none ship).
CFG-DEM-017: judicial review and independent dispute-resolution pathways (the review route a closure names).
CFG-DAT-001: retention and disclosure of the case and of the protected identity.

library.title: Answer an oversight finding
library.intro: The institution a finding concerns gives its official response: whether it accepts the finding, its reasons and evidence, and what it will do. The response is recorded beside the finding; it never changes the finding.
library.filled_by: Officials of the institution the finding concerns, once the body has sent the finding for its response.
library.authority: Filled by the institution the finding concerns (actor_authorized_for_institution); addressed to the body that made the finding, the institution the nation names for its oversight slot (shipped empty). Never a ministry by name.

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it
The body is the institution the nation names for its slot of the deployment profile (ombudsman, humanRights, anticorruption, supremeAudit, dataProtection), shipped empty; it is independent once named
deviations.why: Authority comes from the deployment profile, never a ministry by name; no oversight body ships for a nation.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: authorityFor(); lib/nation/deployment.ts INDEPENDENT_SLOTS (plan I8)

deviations.what: A finding is a recommendation with reasons, never an order or an automatic decision; whatever it asks is done, or not, by the institution concerned under its own procedures
deviations.why: Part 12 §7.3: a recommendation is not automatically a binding order; AI never makes a legally material decision.
deviations.rule: lib/oversight/register.ts; CLAUDE.md Government operating model (AI never makes a legally material decision)

deviations.what: The response is recorded beside the finding: the finding, its versions and its stage are untouched; only the body corrects its own finding, as a new version
deviations.why: Part 4 §C.3 separation rule and acceptance P4-04.

deviations.what: The response is not a step of the body's case: the institution concerned never acts on an independent body's case; it answers through /api/oversight, checked against the finding
deviations.why: An independent institution's cases are worked only by its own officials.

platform.how: respondToFinding(): the official response of the institution concerned, recorded beside the finding

quotes: Finding, responsible institution, response and follow-up
Respondent, response, supporting evidence and date
Owner, agreed or disputed action, due date if established and follow-up status
Separation rule: the audited ministry may respond to a finding and submit evidence, but it must not edit the audit institution's finding or delete its working papers.
A disagreement should be recorded as a response or review, not resolved by overwriting the auditor's record.

platform.how: respondToFinding() never changes the finding; submitEvidence() for evidence the institution submits
